Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📍Location: Romania 
 About Us: 
 20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles . 
 What you’ll find here: 
Digital transformation projects with real impact
A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
Exposure to diverse industries and international environments
Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are looking for a Senior Manual QA Engineer (French) to join a project based in Bucharest. The role focuses on testing batch processes. Testing will not focus on HMI interfaces or APIs. 
 Much of the project documentation is in French, so candidates should ideally speak French or be able to understand it well enough to work with the documentation.
 Responsibilities 
Review project documentation and functional requirements.
Design, prepare, and execute manual tests for batch processes.
Record and track defects, providing clear information to help reproduce them.
Work with the team to clarify requirements and investigate test results.
Contribute to testing and quality assurance throughout the project.
 Requirements 
Strong experience in manual software testing, ideally at a senior level.
Experience testing batch processes.
Attention to detail and the ability to analyze requirements and results.
French speaking skills or a good working understanding of French, especially for reading documentation.
 Automation 
 Automation experience is not required. The project will not include automation work at the beginning. Candidates with automation skills should be comfortable focusing on manual testing initially.
 *Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
